independence_evidence: Contact page states 'Published by TCO London, Unit 2H Zetland House, 109-123 Clifton Street, London EC2A 4LD'; TCO London is a small independent publisher/creative agency that also publishes Huck, not part of a large media group.
qualifies_reason: Independent London film magazine with Issue 115 published October 2026 and a print subscription shop.
what_it_is: A film magazine in which each print issue is built around one new release, with a commissioned illustrated cover and a long section of interviews and essays on that film, followed by reviews and features on other cinema. The illustration-heavy design and the thematic structure are its signature. It suits readers who follow new arthouse and mainstream cinema and want criticism with a strong visual identity.
